title: A Finite-Calibration Regime Map for LLM Judge Panels
abstract: arXiv:2606.01034v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deploying an LLM judge panel spends human labels on fitting a calibrator, constructing candidate judge paths, and validating which candidate to deploy. We study when finite labels should support a low-dimensional stacker or reliability model, and when an unrestricted joint output table is worth its cell-count and unseen-pattern cost. We cast this as a finite-calibration regime map and instantiate it as Finite-Calibration Panel Selection (FCPS), a validation selector over judge path, deployed panel size, and aggregator family with support diagnostics. Across RewardBench, LLMBar, SummEval, and Arena100K with a seven-judge pool, scalar/reliability aggregation has lower MSE than unrestricted joint-table calibration in 16 of 20 real dataset--budget cells by point estimate, while paired 95% intervals exclude zero in 11 cells; richer backoff/shrinkage tables narrow some gaps while preserving the finite-support bottleneck. translated_title: 有限校准机制图：用于大语言模型评审团面板
translated_abstract: 部署大语言模型评审团面板需要花费人工标注来拟合校准器、构建候选评审路径，并验证部署哪个候选。我们研究了在有限标签情况下，何时应支持低维堆叠器或可靠性模型，以及何时无限制的联合输出表值得其单元格计数和未见模式成本。我们将此构建为有限校准机制图，并将其实例化为有限校准面板选择（FCPS），这是一个验证选择器，覆盖评审路径、部署面板大小和聚合器家族，并附带支持诊断。在RewardBench、LLMBar、SummEval和Arena100K上，使用七评审池，标量/可靠性聚合在20个真实数据集-预算单元格中的16个中，其均方误差低于无限制联合表校准（按点估计），而配对95%区间在11个单元格中排除零；更丰富的回退/收缩表缩小了一些差距，同时保留了有限支持瓶颈。受控校准实验进一步验证了这些发现。
tldr: 本文提出了一种有限校准机制图，用于指导大语言模型评审团面板在有限人工标注下选择最优的校准与聚合策略，发现低维标量/可靠性模型在多数场景下优于无限制联合表校准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a finite-calibration regime map to guide LLM judge panel deployment under limited human labels, showing that low-dimensional scalar/reliability aggregation often outperforms unrestricted joint-table calibration in most scenarios.
